{"code": "print("\nFinal verification: number of participants with both valid baseline and follow-up measurements:")
# Valid baseline means not -999.0
valid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0
valid_follow_up = df['biomarker_final'].notnull()

# Both valid
both_valid = valid_baseline & valid_follow_up

print(f"Number of participants with both valid baseline and follow-up: {both_valid.sum()}")

# Compute mean change only on this group
change = df.loc[both_valid, 'biomarker_final'] - df.loc[both_valid, 'biomarker_baseline']
mean_change = change.mean()

print(f"Mean change: {mean_change:.4f} ng/mL")"}
